patch:
diff --git a/.pre-commit-config.yaml b/.pre-commit-config.yaml
index 7156b12..4f36da0 100644
--- a/.pre-commit-config.yaml
+++ b/.pre-commit-config.yaml
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ ci:
 
 repos:
   - repo: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit
-    rev: v0.11.12
+    rev: v0.16.3
     hooks:
       - id: ruff-check
         args: [--fix, --exit-non-zero-on-fix]
diff --git a/pyproject.toml b/pyproject.toml
index 4428d97..5ac811d 100644
--- a/pyproject.toml
+++ b/pyproject.toml
@@ -213,6 +213,7 @@ ignore = [
   "ARG",     # unused arguments are normal when implementing interfaces
   "C901",    # we're complex software
   "COM",     # ruff format takes care of our commas
+  "CPY001",  # we use SPDX headers, not copyright notices
   "D",       # We prefer our own docstring style.
   "E501",    # leave line-length enforcement to ruff format
   "ERA001",  # we need to keep around some notes
@@ -221,11 +222,15 @@ ignore = [
   "ISC001",  # conflicts with ruff format
   "N",       # we need more naming freedom
   "PD",      # we're not pandas
+  "PLC0415", # imports are sometimes done on purpose deeper in the code
   "PLR0912", # we're complex software
   "PLR0913", # yes, many arguments, but most have defaults
   "PLR0915", # we're complex software
+  "PLR0917", # yes, many arguments, but most have defaults
   "PLR2004", # numbers are sometimes fine
   "PLW0603", # sometimes we need globals
+  "PLW1641", # we know what we're doing when we define __eq__ by hand
+  "RUF063",  # we intentionally avoid the newer API in our compat shims
   "S307",    # eval FTW
   "SLF001",  # private members are accessed by friendly functions
   "TC",      # TYPE_CHECKING blocks break autodocs
@@ -246,11 +251,13 @@ ignore = [
   "B018",    # pointless expressions in tests aren't pointless
   "DTZ",     # datetime best practices don't matter in tests
   "EM",      # no need for exception msg hygiene in tests
+  "ISC004",  # implicit string concat in a 1-tuple isn't a missing comma
   "PLE0309", # hash doesn't have to return anything in tests
   "PLR0124", # pointless comparison in tests aren't pointless
   "PT011",   # broad is fine
   "PT012",   # sometimes we need more than a single stmt
   "RUF012",  # we don't do ClassVar annotations in tests
+  "RUF043",  # match text isn't meant to be a regex
   "S",       # security concerns don't matter in tests
   "SIM201",  # sometimes we need to check `not ==`
   "SIM202",  # sometimes we need to check `not ==`
diff --git a/src/attr/_make.py b/src/attr/_make.py
index e84d979..9db4b40 100644
--- a/src/attr/_make.py
+++ b/src/attr/_make.py
@@ -553,7 +553,7 @@ def _frozen_delattrs(self, name):
     """
     Attached to frozen classes as __delattr__.
     """
-    if isinstance(self, BaseException) and name in ("__notes__",):
+    if isinstance(self, BaseException) and name == "__notes__":
         BaseException.__delattr__(self, name)
         return
 
@@ -1082,7 +1082,7 @@ class _ClassBuilder:
 
     def add_replace(self):
         self._cls_dict["__replace__"] = self._add_method_dunders(
-            lambda self, **changes: evolve(self, **changes)
+            lambda self, **changes: evolve(self, **changes)  # noqa: PLW0108
         )
         return self
 
@@ -2848,7 +2848,7 @@ class Converter:
                 value, field
             )
         else:
-            self.__call__ = lambda value, instance, field: self.converter(
+            self.__call__ = lambda value, instance, field: self.converter(  # noqa: PLW0108
                 value, instance, field
             )
 
diff --git a/tests/test_make.py b/tests/test_make.py
index 80c0066..933cde0 100644
--- a/tests/test_make.py
+++ b/tests/test_make.py
@@ -112,9 +112,7 @@ class TestCountingAttr:
 
         assert v == a._validator
 
-    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
-        "wrap", [lambda v: v, lambda v: [v], lambda v: and_(v)]
-    )
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("wrap", [lambda v: v, lambda v: [v], and_])
     def test_validator_decorator(self, wrap):
         """
         If _CountingAttr.validator is used as a decorator and there is already
@@ -1489,9 +1487,7 @@ class TestConverter:
         """
         Converters circumvent immutability.
         """
-        C = make_class(
-            "C", {"x": attr.ib(converter=lambda v: int(v))}, frozen=True
-        )
+        C = make_class("C", {"x": attr.ib(converter=int)}, frozen=True)
         C("1")
